summary: Built the scripted-round benchmark playground and research console: (1) optional latent-board mode in the TypeScript engine (predetermined gray-disc values carried through gravity/rises; default random-reveal behavior byte-identical, verified by the 256-seed parity sweep); (2) src/bench/ with the drop7-scripted-round-v1 format, eight generated Gauntlet rounds from the dedicated 0x5eed**** domain, a deterministic D7P policy registry and runner, CLI, and stdin/stdout D7P server per docs/d7p-protocol.md; (3) a Next.js console in web/ rendering research records, the leaderboard with move-by-move replays, repo docs, and MDX approach documentation (12 hand-written family guides, 3 visual learn pages, 91 generated approach starter pages). No gameplay tiers opened; scripted rounds are playground evidence only.
validationPerformed: npm test (134 tests incl. latent-mode and bench determinism)
make test (native self-tests + 256-seed native/TypeScript parity: exact)
next build + HTTP smoke test of all console routes
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
